items.purpose: To clarify the provision of excess spare parts to the Commission.

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Department of the Navy, the U.S. Space and Rocket Center Commission, and potentially associated nonprofit restoration organizations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Navy... may convey, without consideration, to the U.S. Space and Rocket Center Commission in Huntsville, Alabama... 3 surplus F-14D Tomcat aircraft

dimensions.assessment: Involves the physical transfer of three specific historical museum aircraft items and their maintenance manuals, with no broad economic or societal impact.
dimensions.evidence: all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to 3 surplus F-14D Tomcat aircraft

dimensions.assessment: Required to be conducted at no cost to the federal government; spare parts transfers must be reimbursed at fair market value.
dimensions.evidence: The conveyance of an aircraft under subsection (a) shall be made at no cost to the United States.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a specific, one-off property conveyance and related conditions for designated military surplus property.
A one-time property transfer authority, though conditions and reverter clauses remain permanently in effect.

missing_information: Fair market value estimates for any spare parts transferred by the Commission.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill authorizes the Department of the Navy to transfer three surplus, non-combat F-14D Tomcat aircraft to the U.S. Space and Rocket Center Commission in Huntsville, Alabama, at no cost to the federal government.

card.summary: S. 4784, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027, establishes policies, organizational structures, funding limits, and authorities for Department of Defense and Department of Energy national security programs. It covers military organization, vessel acquisition, counterterrorism, cyber and artificial intelligence, reporting requirements, and military construction.
